name: openbb_equity_management
description:
Executives and key officers of one company (name, title, pay where available) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.management).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp or yfinance; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
Full company profile: openbb_equity_profile; another source: fmp_key_executives. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT", "provider": "yfinance"}
